phases.title: Phase 1 - Foundations
phases.description: Container orchestration from first principles: what Kubernetes actually does, how a cluster is put together, how to drive it with kubectl, and the core objects (Pods, labels, Deployments, Namespaces) every later topic builds on.

weeks.title: Week 1 - Kubernetes and cluster architecture
weeks.description: Why orchestration exists, what the control plane does, and what runs on a worker node.

lessons.title: What Kubernetes is (and what it is not)
lessons.summary: The problem orchestration solves, the declarative model, and the reconciliation loop that underpins every controller.

lessons.title: Cluster architecture: control plane and nodes
lessons.summary: How the control plane and worker nodes divide responsibility, and the path a request takes from kubectl to a running container.

lessons.title: Control plane components in detail
lessons.summary: kube-apiserver, etcd, kube-scheduler and kube-controller-manager: what each one owns and how they fail.

weeks.title: Week 2 - Your lab environment and kubectl
weeks.description: Build a local cluster and become fluent with the CLI you will live in during the exam.

lessons.title: Build your practice cluster with kind and minikube
lessons.summary: Install a local multi-node cluster, understand kubeconfig, and set up the shell aliases that save minutes in the exam.

lessons.title: kubectl fundamentals
lessons.summary: get, describe, logs, exec, apply and the imperative generators - plus the output flags that make debugging fast.

lessons.title: The API object model and writing YAML
lessons.summary: apiVersion, kind, metadata, spec and status; how to discover any field with kubectl explain instead of memorising it.

weeks.title: Week 3 - Pods and the object model
weeks.description: The smallest deployable unit, its lifecycle, and how objects find each other through labels.

lessons.title: Pods deep dive
lessons.summary: Multi-container patterns, init containers, probes, resources and the full Pod lifecycle including every reason a Pod gets stuck.

lessons.title: Labels, selectors and annotations
lessons.summary: The loose-coupling mechanism behind Services, Deployments and node placement - and the selector syntax the exam expects.

weeks.title: Week 4 - Controllers and namespaces
weeks.description: Deployments, ReplicaSets, rollouts and how to keep workloads isolated.

lessons.title: Deployments and ReplicaSets
lessons.summary: Declarative rollouts, rollback, scaling and the exact relationship between a Deployment, its ReplicaSets and its Pods.

lessons.title: Namespaces, contexts and resource quotas
lessons.summary: Scoping objects, switching context without losing time, and the quota/limit-range objects that constrain a namespace.

phases.title: Phase 2 - Workloads & Scheduling
phases.description: The 15% exam domain: how workloads are defined, configured and placed onto nodes. Deployments, rollouts, configuration, autoscaling and the full scheduling toolbox.

weeks.title: Week 5 - Rollouts and workload controllers
weeks.description: Deployment strategies, DaemonSets, StatefulSets, Jobs and CronJobs.

lessons.title: Deployment strategies and rollbacks
lessons.summary: RollingUpdate tuning, maxSurge/maxUnavailable, pausing and rolling back a bad release.

lessons.title: DaemonSets and StatefulSets
lessons.summary: When node-local agents and stable network identities are the right controller.

lessons.title: Jobs and CronJobs
lessons.summary: Run-to-completion workloads, parallelism, backoff limits and scheduled execution.

weeks.title: Week 6 - Application configuration
weeks.description: ConfigMaps, Secrets, environment injection and immutable configuration.

lessons.title: ConfigMaps in practice
lessons.summary: Every way to get configuration into a container and the trade-offs of each.

lessons.title: Secrets and encryption at rest
lessons.summary: Secret types, mounting versus env vars, and enabling encryption providers on the API server.

lessons.title: Resource requests, limits and QoS classes
lessons.summary: How requests drive scheduling, how limits drive eviction, and what Guaranteed/Burstable/BestEffort mean.

weeks.title: Week 7 - Scheduling
weeks.description: Getting the right Pod onto the right node.

lessons.title: nodeSelector, node affinity and pod affinity
lessons.summary: Hard and soft placement rules and when each is evaluated.

lessons.title: Taints and tolerations
lessons.summary: Repelling Pods from nodes, the NoSchedule/NoExecute effects, and control-plane taints.

lessons.title: Topology spread constraints and priority classes
lessons.summary: Spreading replicas across failure domains and deciding what gets preempted under pressure.

weeks.title: Week 8 - Scaling and self-healing
weeks.description: Autoscaling and the probes that keep traffic away from unhealthy Pods.

lessons.title: Horizontal Pod Autoscaling
lessons.summary: metrics-server, HPA v2 targets and reading autoscaler decisions.

lessons.title: Liveness, readiness and startup probes
lessons.summary: Designing probes that fail fast without flapping, and their effect on rollouts.

lessons.title: Helm and Kustomize basics
lessons.summary: Templating and overlay-based configuration management as expected by the current CKA curriculum.

phases.title: Phase 3 - Networking & Storage
phases.description: Two exam domains at once: Services & Networking (20%) and Storage (10%). Cluster networking, Services, Ingress, DNS, NetworkPolicies, volumes, PV/PVC and StorageClasses.

weeks.title: Week 9 - Cluster networking and Services
weeks.description: The network model and the four Service types.

lessons.title: The Kubernetes network model and CNI
lessons.summary: Flat pod networking, CNI plugin responsibilities and how to inspect what your plugin did.

lessons.title: Services: ClusterIP, NodePort, LoadBalancer
lessons.summary: Endpoints, kube-proxy modes and choosing the right exposure for a workload.

lessons.title: CoreDNS and service discovery
lessons.summary: DNS names for Services and Pods, search domains and debugging resolution failures.

weeks.title: Week 10 - Ingress and gateway traffic
weeks.description: HTTP routing into the cluster.

lessons.title: Ingress controllers and rules
lessons.summary: Installing a controller, path and host routing, and TLS termination.

lessons.title: Gateway API introduction
lessons.summary: The successor to Ingress and the parts of it the current CKA blueprint mentions.

lessons.title: NetworkPolicies
lessons.summary: Default-deny patterns, ingress/egress rules and verifying isolation.

weeks.title: Week 11 - Storage fundamentals
weeks.description: Volumes, persistent volumes and claims.

lessons.title: Volumes and volume types
lessons.summary: emptyDir, hostPath, projected volumes and the container filesystem lifecycle.

lessons.title: PersistentVolumes and PersistentVolumeClaims
lessons.summary: Binding, access modes, reclaim policies and why a PVC stays Pending.

lessons.title: StorageClasses and dynamic provisioning
lessons.summary: Provisioners, default classes, volume expansion and binding modes.

weeks.title: Week 12 - Stateful workloads
weeks.description: Putting networking and storage together.

lessons.title: Running stateful workloads
lessons.summary: volumeClaimTemplates, headless Services and ordered rollouts.

lessons.title: Troubleshooting networking and storage
lessons.summary: A repeatable checklist for connectivity and mount failures.

lessons.title: Phase 3 consolidation drill
lessons.summary: Timed exercises spanning Services, Ingress, NetworkPolicy and PVCs.

phases.title: Phase 4 - Cluster Architecture & Administration
phases.description: The 25% exam domain: building and operating clusters. kubeadm, upgrades, etcd backup and restore, RBAC, certificates, node maintenance and extension interfaces.

weeks.title: Week 13 - Building a cluster with kubeadm
weeks.description: From bare nodes to a working cluster.

lessons.title: Bootstrapping a cluster with kubeadm
lessons.summary: Prerequisites, kubeadm init/join, and installing a CNI plugin.

lessons.title: Upgrading a cluster
lessons.summary: Control-plane-first upgrade order, kubeadm upgrade plan/apply and node draining.

lessons.title: Highly available control planes
lessons.summary: Stacked versus external etcd and load-balancing the API server.

weeks.title: Week 14 - etcd and cluster state
weeks.description: The single most exam-relevant administrative skill.

lessons.title: etcd backup and restore
lessons.summary: etcdctl snapshot save/restore with the right certificates, and validating the result.

lessons.title: Certificates, CSRs and kubeconfig
lessons.summary: The PKI layout, renewing certificates and creating a kubeconfig for a new user.

lessons.title: Static Pods and control plane manifests
lessons.summary: How /etc/kubernetes/manifests works and how to edit control plane flags safely.

weeks.title: Week 15 - Access control
weeks.description: Who can do what, from where.

lessons.title: RBAC: Roles, ClusterRoles and bindings
lessons.summary: Designing least-privilege access and verifying it with kubectl auth can-i.

lessons.title: ServiceAccounts and projected tokens
lessons.summary: Workload identity, token projection and automounting.

lessons.title: Admission control basics
lessons.summary: Admission plugins, validating/mutating webhooks and Pod Security admission.

weeks.title: Week 16 - Operations and extensions
weeks.description: Day-two administration.

lessons.title: Node maintenance: cordon, drain, uncordon
lessons.summary: Evicting workloads safely and respecting PodDisruptionBudgets.

lessons.title: CRDs and operators
lessons.summary: Extending the API and recognising operator-managed resources.

lessons.title: Cluster observability
lessons.summary: Metrics, events and logs: what to look at first when something is wrong.

phases.title: Phase 5 - Troubleshooting
phases.description: The largest exam domain at 30%. A systematic method for diagnosing application, cluster, node and network failures under time pressure.

weeks.title: Week 17 - Application and cluster failures
weeks.description: Working from symptom to root cause.

lessons.title: A troubleshooting methodology that scales
lessons.summary: The describe -> events -> logs -> exec loop and how to avoid rabbit holes.

lessons.title: Debugging Pods and containers
lessons.summary: CrashLoopBackOff, ImagePullBackOff, OOMKilled, Pending and Init failures - causes and fixes.

lessons.title: Control plane failures
lessons.summary: A dead API server, an unhealthy scheduler and a corrupted static Pod manifest.

weeks.title: Week 18 - Node and network failures
weeks.description: Below the workload layer.

lessons.title: Diagnosing a NotReady node
lessons.summary: kubelet, container runtime, disk pressure and certificate expiry.

lessons.title: Network troubleshooting
lessons.summary: Service to endpoint to Pod: isolating where traffic stops.

lessons.title: Monitoring and log aggregation
lessons.summary: Where logs live on a node and how to collect them cluster-wide.

phases.title: Phase 6 - Mock Exams & Review
phases.description: Simulation and consolidation. Full-length timed exams, exam-day logistics, speed drills and a targeted review of your weakest domains.

weeks.title: Week 19 - Timed simulations
weeks.description: Two full mock exams under real conditions.

lessons.title: Exam day logistics and environment
lessons.summary: The PSI environment, allowed documentation, the terminal setup and time budgeting.

lessons.title: Mock exam 1
lessons.summary: A two-hour simulation weighted to the real domain percentages.

lessons.title: Mock exam 2
lessons.summary: A second simulation emphasising troubleshooting and cluster administration.

weeks.title: Week 20 - Targeted review
weeks.description: Close the gaps the mocks exposed.

lessons.title: Speed drills and imperative commands
lessons.summary: The generator commands and dry-run patterns that buy you time.

lessons.title: Weak domain review
lessons.summary: Using your dashboard readiness breakdown to decide what to revisit.

lessons.title: Final checklist before booking
lessons.summary: The go/no-go list: what you must be able to do without looking anything up.
